Publish.LongDescription: NetworkTools (Bleeding Edge) The latest experimental version of NetworkTools. May be unstable and contain bugs.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Now Available for testing: AddNode tool - Allows adding nodes to existing road segments. - Significantly improved: Slope tool. - Completely rewritten from scratch, the slope tool should now behave more reliably and give better, more consistent results. - Adds in-world handles for shape manipulation & parameter control. For now this is only used in the EaseInOut slope tool. - For now, the slope tool is limited to roads until more testing and improvements can be done for it to work on other types of networks. - Updates the selection overlay, now outlines the selected segment like in the base game - New tooltip hint system that gives real-time instructions for using tools. - More accurately determine the size of nodes when rendering the overlay - should fix "giant circles" - Redesigned tool icons and polished UI. - Added a few more planned tools to the UI as placeholders. - For now, removes curve / shape tools until they can be re-implemented in the new system. - Many other internal improvements and changes.
